_about: Shared OEM profile cases. lib/oem.test.ts runs them against lib/oem.ts, and flight-mcp/tests/test_oem_profile.py runs the same file against flight-mcp/flight_mcp/oem_profile.py, so the two validators cannot drift. fixtures/oem-profile-expected.json holds the exact validate_oem result for every case, written by scripts/update-oem-golden.mjs from lib/oem.ts.
_format: Start from the lines of `base`. Each edit is applied in order. {replace, with} swaps the one line that equals `replace` exactly for `with` (use \n for several lines, null to delete the line). {append} adds lines at the end. Then validate the result. `valid` is the expected outcome. Each string in `errors_mention` must appear in at least one error. `this_app_wrote` means the file must carry ORIGINATOR = 3ROK. `text_cases` give the whole file as `text` instead of edits to `base`. Both lists are validated with ORIGINATOR required to be 3ROK only when `this_app_wrote` is true.
